caseCreationText: Client & Context//Client: Lumina Networks (High-Speed Hybrid ISP).//Context: The client deployed a private commercial fiber ring to support high-density automated manufacturing zones.////Project Details//Project Duration: 2 Weeks.//Year Completed: 2026.//Estimated Cost: $1,200,000 deployment budget / $8,000 campaign budget.//Project Team: 1 Project Manager, 1 B2B Marketer, 1 Tech Copywriter.////Challenge//Lumina needed to sign up commercial industrial tenants, but municipal zoning delays pushed the final network certification to just 5 days before the district's global trade expo, leaving an extremely narrow window to block market competitors.////Solution//Our 3-person team executed a high-velocity, multi-channel Account-Based Marketing (ABM) strategy:////Targeted Ads: Launched hyper-localized LinkedIn ads aimed strictly at operations directors leasing facilities in the zone.//Direct Outreach: Hand-delivered custom technical bandwidth blueprints and SLA guarantees straight to corporate decision-makers.////Results//The 5-day sprint successfully captured the local industrial market before competitors could react:////Enterprise Contracts: Secured 6 long-term commercial contracts with automated fulfillment hubs within the 5-day window.//Lead Generation: Captured 15 qualified enterprise leads for the upcoming network expansion phase.//Media Amplification: Earned prominent features in 3 regional industrial tech trade journals, generating $35,000 in Advertising Value Equivalency (AVE).
